heading: Management of space programs: joint program offices and officer management programs

tree.heading: Joint Program Offices.—
tree.text: The Secretary of Defense shall take appropriate actions to ensure, to the maximum extent practicable, that space development and acquisition programs of the Department of Defense are carried out through joint program offices.

children.text: The Secretary of Defense shall take appropriate actions to ensure, to the maximum extent practicable, that—
Army, Navy, and Marine Corps officers, as well as Air Force officers, are assigned to the space development and acquisition programs of the Department of Defense; and

Army, Navy, and Marine Corps officers, as well as Air Force officers, are eligible, on the basis of qualification, to hold leadership positions within the joint program offices referred to in subsection (a).

The Secretary of Defense shall designate those positions in the Office of the National Security Space Architect of the Department of Defense (or any successor office) that qualify as joint duty assignment positions for purposes of chapter 38 of this title.

notes.heading: Continuation of Operation of Defense Meteorological Satellite Program
notes.text: Pub. L. 119–60, div. A, title XVI, § 1606, Dec. 18, 2025, 139 Stat. 1176, provided that: “The Secretary of Defense shall continue to operate the Defense Meteorological Satellite Program, and its existing functions and distribution capability, until the end of the functional life of the satellites in orbit as of the date of the enactment of this Act [Dec. 18, 2025] under such program.”

notes.heading: Limitation on Use of Commercial Satellite Services and Associated Systems
notes.text: Pub. L. 117–81, div. A, title XVI, § 1607(b), Dec. 27, 2021, 135 Stat. 2079, provided that: “(1) In general.—Except as provided by paragraph (2), the Secretary of Defense may not rely solely on the use of commercial satellite services and associated systems to carry out operational requirements, including command and control requirements, targeting requirements, or other requirements that are necessary to execute strategic and tactical operations. “(2) Mitigation measures.—The Secretary may rely solely on the use of commercial satellite services and associated systems to carry out an operational requirement described in paragraph (1) if the Secretary has taken measures to mitigate the vulnerability of any such requirement.”
